title: TDD with ASP.NET Core
description: Apply TDD to build ASP.NET Core applications.

data.text: **TDD with ASP.NET Core** applies test-driven development to build APIs and web applications. It ensures your endpoints work correctly from the start.

data.title: TDD API Example

data.takeaway: TDD ensures your ASP.NET Core APIs work correctly from the start.
